description: Geocode US address: Street address → coordinates and parsed components using the US Census Bureau Geocoder (free, no key). Source: US Census Bureau. US addresses only; street-segment interpolation, not rooftop. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: match_count, matches[{matched_address, lat, lon, components}].
